name: lending_transactions
summary: Loan disbursements, repayments, payment allocation and reversals
description: Companion for the lending module: disbursement requests with gross/net breakdown, provider references and idempotency keys; repayment capture with received/confirmed/unallocated separation; installment-level payment allocation across fees, penalties, interest and principal; and reversals that correct posted history immutably. Money movements carry accounting posting references but the loan subledger remains authoritative.
author: Nexa
